name: Dr. Ajeet Madhavrao Gopchade
education: M.B.B.S., M.D. (Paediatrics) Educated at Prativa Niketan High School, Nanded, Maharashtra, Yashwant College Nanded, Maharashtra, Government Medical College, Aurangabad, Maharshtra and Swami Ramanand Teerth Rural Government Medical College, Ambajogai, Maharashtra
profession: Doctor, Medical Practitioner, Agriculturist, Organic Farmer, Research, Political and Social Worker, Teacher and Educationist and Sportsperson
present_address: Flat No. 201 Brahmaputra Complex, Dr. B.D. Marg, New Delhi - 110001
permanent_address: Amruthpath Hospital, Doctor Lane, Near Railway Station, Nanded 431601
social_activities: Complete devotion to medical fraternity; President, Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Seva Pratishthan, Nanded, Maharashtra; runs 2 girls’ schools and one junior college in Nanded district for under privileged girls; regularly arranges free garbha sanskar camps for pregnant women in Nanded district through Amrutpath Hospital, Nanded; Research work in Medicine (published in India): (i) Mentzer Index for Differential Diagnosis of Iron Deficiency Anemia and Beta Thalassemia Trait, Journal of Medical Science and Clinical Research, (vol. 4, issue 12, Dec. 2016, p. 15138-42, indexed in index Copernicus), (ii) Umbilical Cord Bilirubin levels as a predictor of subsequent development of clinically significant Neonatal Hyper-bilirubinemia Journal of Medical Science and Clinical Research, (vol. 5, issue 2, February 2017, p. 17829-35, indexed in index Copernicus), (iii) Hemorrhagic Disease of Newborn; A prospective Study of Clinical Features and Outcome, International Journal of Medical Science and Clinical Invention, (vol. 5, issue 1, January 2018, p. 3413-17, indexed in index Copernicus), (iv) Fetomaternal Outcome in Polyhydramnios, Annals of International Medical and Dental Research, (vol. 4, issue 5, August 2018, p.19-23, indexed in index Copernicus), (v) Etiological Profile of Children Presenting with First-Onset Seizures: A Prospective Study, Annals of International Medical and Dental Research, (vol. 5, issue 6, June 2019, p. 13-16, indexed in index Copernicus), (vi) Electrolyte Disturbances in Children Presenting with Acute Diarrhoea: A Prospective Cohort Study, Journal of Medical Science and Clinical Research, (vol. 7, issue 9, September 2019, p. 777-783, indexed in index Copernicus) and (vii) Urinary Tract Infection in Pediatric Age Group: A Prospective Disease, Journal of Medical Science and Clinical Research, (vol. 7, issue 10, October 2019, p. 276-281, indexed in index Copernicus); Recipient of (i) National level award by Central Council of Indian Medical Association, (ii) National level Social Welfare award in programme at Latur, Maharashtra, (iii) Certificate as Yoga teacher by Patanjali Yoga Vidyapeeth, Haridwar; additional work related to medical field: Founder, Amrutpath Maternity and Child Care Hospital, Nanded, Maharashtra; established a generic medicine store under Jan Aushadhi Scheme at Dr. Shankarrao Chavan, Government Medical College, Nanded; worked in organic farming sector for uplifting of poor and needy farmers of Nanded district with Harshal Jain, international organic certifier in 2016-2017; worked for formation of Para Medical Council in Maharashtra; took efforts to start e-learning in Maharashtra University of Health Sciences, Nashik, Maharashtra; provided daily essentials, etc. to the people of village Ganjgaon, Nanded, struck by natural disaste;, started research education all over Maharashtra through software tools in all U.G. and P.G. medical courses; Chief Coordinator for council elections for Vaidyakiya Aaghadi panel for Allopathy, Dental, Homeopathy, Ayurvedic, Pharmacy and M.U.H.S., Nashik; established a strong network of Medical, Dental, and Medical student wing, paramedical staff and workers in Maharashtra; runs an old age home for the poor and needy, under the Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Seva Pratishthan, Nanded, an NGO; President, Golwalkar Guruji Blood Bank, Nanded; implemented the ‘Rashtramata Jijau Kuposhanmukti Abhiyan – 2013’; provided free treatment to 4500 children; undertook yoga camps at Nanded district and nearby areas; has undertaken free medical checkup camps, including a medical camp at the Mahakumbha Mela, Nashik, Maharashtra in 2015; regularly organised medical camps in the drought affected areas of Marathwada; has been conducting free annual medical camps for poor sections of the society; organised free HIV/ Blood group checkup camps for drivers and underprivileged sections of the society; gives talks on Akashwani on the topics including, child health, malnourishment, neonatal mortality on a regular basis; worked in rescue operations after the earthquake in September 1993 at Khillari and Sastur region Marathwada of Maharashtra in year 1996-1997; successfully implemented the P.H.I. scheme of AYUSH for school going students on chronic respiratory disease under the Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Seva Pratishthan, Nanded, an NGO; has undertaken various blood donation camps throughout Nanded district and Maharashtra; organized free medical camps through Amrutpath Hospital ; started joining about eighty five thousand booths having 2 swastha swayam sevaks, 1 male doctor and 1 female doctor all over Maharashtra; work against Covid-19: started CME online application through Maharashtra Medical Council; created a medical helpline through the Medical cell Maharashtra; built a strong organization of various dedicated doctors for guidance through the helpline; has worked to fight against CORONA (Covid-19); setup a chain of doctors, dentists, pharmacists, paramedical staff and hospital workers to contribute to fight against COVID-19 in all over Maharashtra; started COVID-19 care centers at Mumbai, Pune and Nanded, Maharashtra; gave 70 bedded Amrutpath hospital to setup Covid 19 care center; was President, Guru-ta-Gaddi Abhiwadan yatra, organized at Nanded in 2008; recipient of (i) National level award by Central Council of Indian Medical Association, (ii) National level Social Welfare award (awarded at a programme held at Latur, Maharashtra) and (iii) Certificate as Yoga teacher by Patanjali Yoga Vidyapeeth, Haridwar; interest in medical research, recent advances; writing articles on medicine, health and related subjects in national and international publications
hobbies: Cricket, swimming, badminton, table tennis, meditation, yoga and pranayam
countries_visited: Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, China and Uzbekistan for medical research and to attend various conferences
other_information: Lecturer, Pediatric department, Dr. Shankarrao Chavan Government, Medical College, Nanded, for 3 years; Assistant Lecturer, Swami Ramanand Teerth Rural Government Medical College, Ambajogai, Distt. Beed; has also worked as a yoga teacher; has worked in Ayurveda, Homoeopathy, Naturopathy, Yoga, Accupressure, Paramedical, Dentist, Chemist, Pharmacist, AASHA workers, Anganwadi Sevika Organisations; Vice-President, Akhil BharatiyaVirshaiva Lingayat Mahasabha, Maharashtra; Deputy President and District Convener, Patanjali Yoga Samiti, Nanded branch of Yoga Vidyapeeth, Haridwar, respectively for one year; working actively for the B.J.P. since 1999; Vice-President, (i) B.J.P., Maharashtra and (ii) B.J.P., District Nanded, 2004-2010; State-In-charge, Maharashtra State Medical Cell, B.J.P.; Vice-President, Maharashtra Medical Council, Mumbai since 2023; Convenor, (i) Rugna Mitra Abhiyan, B.J.P., Maharashtra, (ii) National Health Volunteer Abhiyan, Maharashtra, (iii) Medical Cell, B.J.P., Maharashtra, 2016-2023, (iv) Ethical Committee-II Maharashtra Medical Council, Mumbai and (v) Ethical Committee-IV Maharashtra Medical Council, Mumbai; In-charge, (i) Lok Sabha elections for Dharashiv and Beed districts and (ii) Beed, Latur and Dharashiv Cluster; was In-charge, Nanded Lok Sabha constituency, 2004 and 2009, (ii) Lok Sabha and Vidhan Sabha Elections, for Prabhani and Yavatmal District, 2019; was assigned the responsibility of Karnataka and Telangana Assembly elections, 2023; was In-charge of Manipur; Nanded, Latur, Dharashiv, Jalna and Dhule constituencies (Maharashtra) and Patiala (Panjab), Lok Sabha elections, 2024; General Secretary, B.J.P., District Nanded, 2010-2016; was President, Maharashtra State Residential Doctors Association; Member, (i) Maharashtra Medical Council, Mumbai, (ii) Maharashtra State, Nursing, Council, Mumbai, (iii) Grievance Committee, Maharashtra University of Health Sciences (M.U.H.S.), Nashik, Maharashtra, (iv) Finance and Account Committee, M.U.H.S., (v) Board of Student’s Welfare, M.U.H.S., (vi) Management Council, M.U.H.S. (nominated by Governor of Maharashtra) and (vii) National Road Safety Council, Government of India; Advisory Member, (i) Pre-Conception and Pre-Natal Diagnostic Techniques (PCPNDT)
